Name: Adamantine Breastplate
Source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 124, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 464
Description: This nonmagical breastplate is made of adamantine, giving its wearer damage reduction 2/—.

Name: Advocate's Armor
Description: The papery layers of this robe barely constitute what would be traditionally called armor, yet act as +3 leather armor. Once per day, when the wearer is struck by a critical hit or sneak attack, he can choose to have his blood splatter across one of the paper layers and form the words of a binding deal between the attacker and the wearer. The wearer can put the opponent under a specific restriction for 24 hours, such as “I will not attack elves,” or “I will attack only those who attacked me first.” The terms of the contract must be simple enough for the creature to comprehend and spoken in a language it understands. This acts as a lesser geas spell, except without a limit to how many Hit Dice the target can have. A successful DC 19 Will save negates this effect.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: geas/quest, Special: creator must make a pact with a devil.

Name: Alchemist's Suit
Description: This bizarre +1 quilted cloth armor holds eight small vials that can be filled with potions, poisons, or other alchemical substances, plus numerous decoys. If the wearer is struck by a bludgeoning attack or critical hit, is grappled, takes constrict damage, or is swallowed whole, the wearer can choose one vial to break as an immediate action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity. The wearer must choose himself or his attacker as the target of the vial’s contents, which immediately produce their effect. If the wearer is the target, the effect functions at half strength and for half the normal duration (minimum 1 round). For example, a potion of cure moderate wounds broken in this manner cures half as many hit points as normal. If the wearer’s opponent is the target, the wearer must attempt a touch attack against the opponent to apply the effect. If the attack is successful, the opponent is affected as if struck by the vial’s contents. If the vial contains a substance that would harm the opponent only upon ingestion, the opponent can avoid being affected if she succeeds at a DC 15 Reflex save.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: shrink item

Name: All-Seeing Armor
Description: This +1 chain shirt is made of shiny, bright rings on the left side and dull, dark rings on the right. At will, the wearer can use detect magic and read magic. Once per day, the wearer can use comprehend languages

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: comprehend languages, detect magic, read magic

Name: Aquadynamic Armor
Description: This sleek and mobile armor is magically streamlined to assist in swimming rather than making swimming more difficult, granting the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Swim checks.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, freedom of movement, water breathing

Name: Aquadynamic Armor, Improved
Description: This sleek and mobile armor is magically streamlined to assist in swimming rather than making swimming more difficult, granting the wearer a +10 competence bonus on Swim checks.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, freedom of movement, water breathing

Name: Aquadynamic Armor, Greater
Description: This sleek and mobile armor is magically streamlined to assist in swimming rather than making swimming more difficult, granting the wearer a +15 competence bonus on Swim checks.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, freedom of movement, water breathing

Name: Arachnid Harness
Description: This formfitting black +1 leather features eight ridged support ribs along the back. On command, the arachnid harness sprouts eight enormous spidery legs from these ribs. These legs allow the armor’s wearer to attempt Climb checks at full speed without needing to use her hands or feet. Additionally, while the legs are deployed, the armor’s wearer doesn’t lose her Dexterity bonus to AC while climbing, and need not succeed at a Climb check to avoid falling if she takes damage while climbing.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: spider climb

Name: Arboreal Armor
Description: The oaken plates of this +1 wild wooden armor are rough with untreated bark. The wearer can activate the armor with a command word, causing her flesh to become treelike in appearance and resilience. This grants the wearer a +4 enhancement bonus to her existing natural armor bonus and removes her need to breathe, but reduces her speed by half and imposes a –2 penalty on Reflex saves. This effect remains until dismissed as a free action. The wearer can use this ability for up to 10 rounds per day, though the rounds need not be consecutive.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor Spells: baleful polymorph, barkskin

Name: Armiger's Armor
Description: This +1 adamantine light fortification full plate is crafted from tightly fitted smooth, dull plates trimmed in gold. As adamantine heavy armor, it grants its wearer DR 3/—. When the armor is not worn, a creature can touch the armor and speak a command word to cause the armor to leap up and fit itself to that creature. The armor is considered properly donned when put on in this way. The wearer can speak the command word to have the armor remove itself and, if not restrained, stack itself neatly nearby or arrange itself on an appropriate armor rack, if one is adjacent.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: animate objects, limited wish or miracle, Special: creator must be proficient with heavy armor.

Name: Armor of Fragmenting Stone
Description: This imposing suit of armor, first forged by elemental binders, is covered in large, jagged stones and functions as +2 full plate. Once per day as an immediate action, when a bludgeoning or slashing attack strikes the wearer, the wearer can will a chunk of the stone to break off, summoning a Medium earth elemental as summon monster IV. The elemental fights as the wearer directs (and understands the wearer, even if the two do not share a language) for 7 rounds, or until it is destroyed.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: summon monster IV or summon nature's ally IV, Special: creator must have visited the Elemental Planes of Earth.

Name: Armor of Insults
Description: Each metal bit of this suit of +1 studded leather looks more like a tiny sneering face than a simple stud. Once per day the wearer of the armor may command the mouths to unleash a torrent of verbal abuse directed against every hostile creature within 60 feet who can see and hear the wearer. Each such creature must make a DC 16 Will saving throw to avoid suffering an overwhelming compulsion to attack the wearer for the next 7 rounds. If the creature is unable to attack the wearer on its next turn, or attacking the wearer would put the creature at risk (moving through a threatened square, charging into a pit, and so on) it can act normally that turn. This is a mind-affecting sonic effect, and has no effect on creatures that do not use a spoken language.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: confusion

Name: Armor of the Pure Legion
Description: This suit of +1 steel lamellar armor grants its wearer spell resistance against divine spells equal to 5 + the wearer’s base attack bonus. It also protects the wearer from heat dangers as if she were affected by a continuous endure elements spell. Additionally, once per day when the wearer of a suit of armor of the Pure Legion fails a Will save against a mind-affecting spell cast by a divine spellcaster, she can attempt another save as a free action on the following round to end the spell.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: endure elements, mind blank

Name: Armor of the Sands
Description: This +2 leather armor is made of camel hide and has been worn smooth as if blasted by sand. The wearer is protected from mundane extremes of cold and heat (as the endure elements spell), and can see normally in sandstorms, dust storms, and similar conditions. Once per day as a swift or immediate action, the wearer can briefly turn to sand when hit by an attack but before damage is determined. For the purposes of resolving the damage, the wearer is treated as an incorporeal creature. Only a single attack is affected by each use of this ability.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: stoneskin

Name: Armor of the Unquenchable Fire
Description: This blue-black +1 defiant chainmail has a metal badge depicting a three-dagger symbol fused to it. Each of these suits of armor is crafted with a particular type of foe in mind for the defiant property, as appropriate for the vengeance the original crafter sought. Once per day, the wearer can use charm person (lasting 1 hour)

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: charm person, summon monster I

Name: Backbreaker Mail
Description: This +2 spiked splint mail is fashioned from hacked-off chunks of tanned hide and held together by humanoid spines. Used by orcs, these sets of armor are seen as a status symbol, and are adorned with trophies from slain foes, such as wayfinders. This armor grants its wearer the constrict ability, dealing an amount of damage equal to 1d6 + the wearer’s Strength modifier. The vertebrae of the spines adorning the backbreaker mail are sharpened, acting as +1 human bane armor spikes.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: beast shape I, disguise self, summon monster I

Name: Banded Mail of Luck
Description: Ten 100-gp gems adorn this +3 banded mail. Once per week, the armor allows its wearer to require that an attack roll made against him be rerolled. He must take whatever consequences come from the second roll. The wearer’s player must decide whether to have the attack roll rerolled before damage is rolled.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: bless

Name: Blackfingers Apron
Description: This +1 bitter leather armor looks much like a blacksmith’s apron or an alchemist’s smock, and has many small pockets suitable for holding extracts, potions, or poisons. Once per day, the wearer can use negate aroma (lasting 1 hour). This effect suspends the armor’s bitter special ability if used on the wearer. Once per day, the wearer can pull a tanglefoot bag from one of the apron’s pockets, although the bag crumbles into dust if it is not used within 1 minute

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: negate aroma, stinking cloud, web

Name: Boneless Leather
Description: This suit of +1 leather gives its wearer the ability to twist and contort her body in virtually any direction. She gains a +5 bonus on Escape Artist checks, a +5 bonus on Acrobatics checks to reduce damage from falls, a +5 bonus to CMD, and DR 5/piercing or slashing.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: alter self, Special: creator must have 5 ranks in Acrobatics and Escape Artist.

Name: Breastplate of Command
Description: This +2 breastplate typically bears the image of a rampant grizzly bear or other impressive predator. It bestows a commanding aura upon its wearer. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on all Charisma checks, including Charisma-based skill checks. The wearer also gains a +2 competence bonus to his Leadership score. Friendly troops within 360 feet of the user become braver than normal, gaining a +2 resistance bonus on saving throws against fear. Since the effect arises in great part from the distinctiveness of the armor, it does not function if the wearer hides or conceals herself in any way.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: mass charm monster

Name: Breastplate of the Planes
Description: This sturdy, unadorned breastplate has a +1 enhancement bonus on the Material Plane. On any Elemental Planes, or against attacks made by creatures native to any Elemental Planes, its enhancement bonus increases to +2. On the Astral Plane or the Ethereal Plane, or against attacks made by creatures native to either of those planes, its enhancement bonus increases to +3. On any other plane, or against attacks made by any outsider, its enhancement bonus increases to +4.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: plane shift

Name: Breastplate of Vanishing
Description: This battered +1 mithral breastplate bears a resemblance to a stylized turtle shell. On command, its wearer can vanish inside the armor, leaving the breastplate behind while she stays safely hidden in an extradimensional space. This space is barely large enough for the wearer to sit comfortably, but does provides breathable air and light to see by. The wearer cannot perceive the environs around the armor while inside. A second command word returns the wearer to the armor’s location, wearing the armor. If the wearer can’t return to the space the armor is in, she is instead shunted to the nearest empty space that can contain her, but no longer wearing the armor. If the breastplate is destroyed, the wearer immediately returns to the square the armor was in when it was destroyed. Successfully dispelling the armor likewise returns the wearer, though in this case still wearing the armor.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: rope trick

Name: Buccaneer's Breastplate
Description: This +1 breastplate is made of shining amber metal and decorated with faint motifs of the waves and water. It allows the wearer to continually utilize the effects of the spell water walk. If a creature puts on the armor while underwater, the wearer is borne toward the surface at a rate of 60 feet per round.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: water walk

Name: Catskin Leather
Description: Rather than the hide of a cat, this extremely supple suit of jet-black +1 shadow leather armor grants a portion of the grace and fortune of a feline. It has no armor check penalty or maximum Dexterity bonus. The wearer receives a +5 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks and takes only half normal damage from falling. When the wearer’s hit points would be reduced to a negative amount equal to her Constitution score from an attack or spell, the armor falls to pieces and is destroyed, and the wearer takes only half damage from the attack or spell.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: cat's grace, feather fall, and limited wish, or miracle

Name: Celestial Armor
Description: This +3 chainmail is so fine and light that it can be worn under normal clothing without betraying its presence. It has a maximum Dexterity bonus of +8, an armor check penalty of –2, and an arcane spell failure chance of 15%. It is considered light armor and allows the wearer to use fly on command (as the spell) once per day.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: fly, Special: creator must be good

Name: Celestial Plate Armor (3.5E)
Description: Celestial plate armor is a sturdier version of the standard celestial armor. This bright silver suit of +3 full plate is remarkably light, and is treated as medium armor. It has a maximum Dexterity bonus of +6, an armor check penalty of –3, and an arcane spell failure chance of 20%. It allows the wearer to use fly on command (as the spell) once per day.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: fly, Special: creator must be good

Name: Chain Vest of Dawn
Description: This red-and-gold +1 spell storing chain shirt is designed to be worn over or between multiple layers of clothing such as garments suited for desert-traveling. At will, the wearer can use light and stabilize.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: light, stabilize, Special: creator must be a caster of at least 12th level

Name: Clockwork Armor
Description: This suit of +2 field plate is composed of durable plates of steel layered over an intricate framework of gears, springs, and pistons that move with mechanical precision. A suit of clockwork armor requires a special winding key to function; this key is created as part of making a suit of clockwork armor. In order to function, a suit of clockwork armor must be fully wound as a full-round action. Once fully wound, a suit of clockwork armor functions for 4 hours. If a suit of clockwork armor is not fully wound, its gears grind to a halt and it imposes double its normal armor check penalty and a –2 penalty to its wearer’s Strength and Dexterity scores. Donning or removing a suit of unwound clockwork armor requires 10 minutes. When fully wound, a suit of clockwork armor can be donned or removed as a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity. It grants the wearer a +4 temporary enhancement bonus to Strength and Constitution, and its weight does not count against the wearer’s total encumbrance. A single crossbow or firearm sized appropriately for the wearer can be added to the armor with a successful DC 20 Craft (armorer) check. Such a weapon can be fired once as a standard action by the wearer, then automatically reloads itself in 2d4 rounds, as long as the wearer has the appropriate ammunition in his gear.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: animate objects

Name: Coruscating Raiment
Description: Originally crafted by jyoti armorsmiths of the Positive Energy Plane, this gleaming suit of +1 radiant full plate has a mirror-like sheen that reflects even tiny sparks of light into brilliant ribbons of blazing color. Its ability to shine as brightly as a torch cannot be suppressed unless the wearer is in magical darkness. Once per day as an immediate action while charging, the wearer can transform her body into brilliant light. The wearer becomes incorporeal until she arrives at the end of her charge and makes her physical attacks, and she can charge through any creatures and obstacles that do not hinder incorporeal creatures (although she must have line of sight to her target when she begins her charge, as normal).

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: sunburst

Name: Crag Linnorm Plate
Description: This specialized suit of full plate is made from the tanned hide of a linnorm and acts as +4 dragonhide plate. If a creature is slain while wearing such armor, its killer is subject to a curse. The cursed creature must succeed at a DC 17 Will save or gain vulnerability to fire until the curse is removed. This curse can be removed only by a break enchantment, miracle, or wish spell. This particular suit of armor is made from the hide of a crag linnorm, though others exist, each with a different curse effect similar to the curse of the associated linnorm. Once per day as a swift action, the wear of this armor can summon forth the uncanny movement powers of a linnorm, gaining the benefits of freedom of movement for 10 minutes.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: form of the dragon I, dreedom of movement, major curse

Name: Daystar Half-Plate
Description: This glowing +1 half-plate is decorated with various images of the sun and depictions of nature. At will, the wearer can command the armor to shine with a daylight spell for 10 minutes. Once per day, the wearer can command it to shine as per the sunburst spell. The sunburst is centered on the wearer and the wearer is immune to its effects.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: daylight, sunburst

Name: Death's Preservation Banded Mail
Description: This +2 light fortification banded mail has a small, ovoid stone set in the left shoulder. The armor monitors the wearer’s hit point total as the spell status. If an attack against the wearer does enough damage to kill him outright, he and his gear are teleported to a specific location determined at the time of the armor’s creation. This effect acts in all other ways as the spell word of recall, with the predetermined location considered the place of sanctuary. The wearer’s body is protected from decomposition for 18 days as per the gentle repose spell. Once this ability has been used, the stone set into the armor crumbles to dust and the armor reverts to being a suit of +2 light fortification banded mail.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: contingency, gentle repose, limited wish or miracle, word of recall

Name: Demon Armor
Description: This plate armor is fashioned to make the wearer appear to be a demon. Glowing red energy emanates from sigils engraved on the armor’s key plates and joints, and the runes intermittently surge with fiendish power. This +4 full plate allows the wearer to make claw attacks that deal 1d10 points of damage, strike as +1 weapons, and afflict the target as if she had been struck by a contagion spell (Fortitude DC 14 negates). Use of contagion requires a normal melee attack with the claws. The “claws” are built into the armor’s vambraces and gauntlets, and cannot be disarmed. A suit of demon armor is infused with evil, and as a result it bestows one negative level on any nonevil creature wearing it. This negative level persists as long as the armor is worn and disappears when the armor is removed. The negative level cannot be overcome in any way (including restoration spells) while the armor is worn.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: contagion

Name: Diviner's Blight
Description: Aside from its superb craftsmanship, this +4 leather armor has little to distinguish it from any other armor. Once per week, while a living creature wears a suit of diviner’s blight armor, the wearer can recite a command word and spend 1 minute in concentration to have the armor imitate a creature with which the wearer is familiar. The imitated creature must be within one size category of the wearer. Imitating a creature has no visible effect on the armor or the wearer, but instead confounds magical divinations. Spells such as scrying meant to observe the imitated creature instead observe the wearer, who appears to the scryer as the imitated creature; the imitated creature still attempts any necessary saving throw or applies its spell resistance, but if the spell succeeds, diviner’s blight redirects any scrying sensor to its wearer. Magical means of detecting a creature’s location always consider the location of the wearer as the actual location of the imitated creature, and only 8th-level or higher spells like discern location or greater prying eyes can overcome this effect. Spells such as detect lies or zone of truth react as though the wearer were the imitated target and not himself, but only for the purpose of stating his identity. Diviner’s blight would not, for instance, affect a question about the wearer’s mother’s name. The imitation remains in place until the wearer chooses a different creature to imitate or spends 1 minute in concentration to end it. The armor resumes its normal form when removed, but the target of its imitative effect remains set—when a character dons the armor (whether the character who dons the armor is the last wearer or a different person), the armor immediately begins imitating the creature it’s set to imitate again.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: misdirection, project image

Name: Djezet Skin
Description: When unattended, djezet skin appears as a curiously smooth sphere of rust-red metal. When it’s held and a command word is spoken, the armor oozes across the wearer’s body like a second skin. The armor can be removed as a free action by stepping out of it, causing it to pool on the floor. Djezet skin acts as a suit of +1 leather, except it is made of metal (and thus druids cannot wear it) and has no armor check penalty and a 0% chance of arcane spell failure. Additionally, the wearer of djezet skin gains a +5 circumstance bonus on Diplomacy checks to make requests of creatures with an attitude of friendly or helpful.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: charm person

Name: Dragonform Armor
Description: This +1 leather armor is the same color as the dragon type with which it is associated and has been worked to resemble dragon hide. Once per day the wearer can speak the command word and transform into the associated dragon type as the form of the dragon I spell. This effect lasts 11 minutes.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: form of the dragon I

Name: Dragonhide Plate
Description: This suit of full plate is made of dragonhide, rather than metal, so druids can wear it. It is otherwise identical to masterwork full plate. The wearer of dragonhide plate tends to draw the ire of dragons of the same type as that used in the armor’s creation.

Name: Dueling Armor
Description: The wearer of these +2 armored coats gain a +2 enhancement bonus on initiative checks and a +2 circumstance bonus on attacks of opportunity if the attacks are made with a dueling sword. Once per day when the wearer of dueling armor is the target of a melee attack, she can make an attack with a dueling sword as an immediate action. If the result of her attack roll is higher than that of her attacker, the wearer of dueling armor parries the attack and takes no damage.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: cat's grace, symbol of striking

Name: Dwarven Plate
Description: This full plate is made of adamantine, giving its wearer damage reduction 3/—.

Name: Elemental Bulwark
Description: This +2 chainmail is attuned to a specific kind of element when created (acid, cold, electricity, or fire) and takes on a colored sheen based on the elemental type (green for acid, blue for cold, silver for electricity, or red for fire.) On command, the wearer of an elemental bulwark can create an effect identical to fire shield, except its effects apply to the type of elemental damage chosen when the armor was crafted. This effect lasts for up to 10 rounds per day, but these rounds need not be used consecutively. Ending this effect is a free action.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: fire shield

Name: Elven Chain
Description: This extremely light chainmail is made of very fine mithral links. This armor is treated, in all ways, like light armor, including when determining proficiency. The armor has an arcane spell failure chance of 20%, a maximum Dexterity bonus of +4, and an armor check penalty of –2.

Name: Elven Dress Uniform
Description: This finely crafted +1 mithral parade armor is as light and comfortable as regular clothing. An elven dress uniform counts as a courtier’s outfit (including appropriate jewelry) when the wearer is interacting with nobles or courtiers, in addition to providing a +2 circumstance bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks to influence people from the elven home nation. Further, the wearer also gains a +2 competence bonus on Perception and Sense Motive checks to intuit that a creature is concealing its true beliefs, feelings, or motives.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: owl's wisdom, Special: creator must be an elf

Name: Elven Vengeance
Description: This set of +2 elven chain grants its wearer a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against spells, spell-like abilities, and other effects created by worshipers and minions of a specific demon lord, chosen when the armor is created. Against such foes, the armor’s enhancement bonus increases to +4.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: detect evil, resistance

Name: Emissary’s Breastplate
Description: When not being worn, this simple steel +1 breastplate appears to be typical magic armor. When worn by a cavalier with the banner class feature, an emissary’s breastplate automatically displays the cavalier’s heraldry and counts as his banner. As long as the cavalier is not in disguise, he is considered to be displaying his banner while wearing the armor. Additionally, the wearer can expend a use of his challenge ability to speak on behalf of himself, his lord, or other agent who has given him the authority to do so. This allows him to use tongues (as per the spell) and issue a single command (as per the spell).

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: arcane mark, command, tongues, Special:: creator must have 5 ranks in knowledge (nobility)

Name: Empyreal Armor
Description: Legend tells that the first suits of empyreal armor were forged from the battered, cast-off breastplates worn by solars in battle. These suits were gifted to powerful mortal heroes and have since changed hands many times. Empyreal armor is made of steel forged so that it reflects a golden sheen in the sunlight. This armor functions as a suit of +3 moderate fortification full plate. In addition, three times per day, its wearer can activate a fire shield (warm shield only) that lasts for 13 rounds. Any creature attacking the wearer with its body or a handheld weapon while the fire shield effect is active deals normal damage but takes 1d6+13 points of damage in return. Half this damage is fire damage, but the other half results directly from divine power and is therefore not subject to energy resistance.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: fire shield, limited wish or miracle

Name: Enchanted Eelskin
Description: This +1 slick leather armor is made of shining, slippery eelskin that allows the wearer to move with deadly grace and sudden swiftness, especially underwater. When immersed in water, enchanted eelskin gains the shadow property and grants the wearer a swim speed of 30 feet and the ability to breathe water. In addition, during a surprise round the wearer can act as if she had a full round of actions, rather than a single standard action, as long as those actions do not require leaving the water. If she does leave the water, her surprise round turn immediately ends.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: grease, invisibility, touch of the sea

Name: Equestrian Plate
Description: Shined to a mirror finish, this suit of +2 full plate is decorated with gold inlay. As a move action when the wearer is mounted, the plates of the armor expand and reposition to protect the wearer’s mount. In this form, the armor becomes a suit of +2 banded mail for the wearer and a suit of +1 banded mail barding worn by the mount. A second move action merges it back into +2 full plate. Equestrian plate cannot transform and protect a mount more than one size larger than its wearer or a creature that cannot wear barding. It can create exotic barding, however, such as for a griffon or dragon. If extra enhancements or spells are placed upon equestrian plate in full plate form, they affect only the wearer’s armor when the suit is split. Effects on the barding are suppressed when it is merged into the armor. If either suit of armor is broken while separated, the other half immediately gains the broken condition as well. Destroying one suit destroys the other as well.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: fabricate

Name: Eternal Iron Breastplate
Description: This +1 stanching breastplate is battle-scarred but polished with great care, and has a small sword-and-mountain symbol hammered just below the gorget. Once per day, the wearer can use compel hostility; if an adjacent ally is reduced to negative hit points or killed, the wearer may activate this as an immediate action instead of a standard action

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: compel hostility,, stabilize, either cure critical wounds or lesser restoration

Name: Fangtide Scale Mail
Description: This +1 glamered scale mail is decorated with fangs and is usually made from the hide of a reptilian beast such as a basilisk. The wearer can use burst bonds and wrath each once per day; as a full-round action, the wearer can activate both of these abilities at the same time

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: burst bonds, disguise self, wrath

Name: Field Medic's Breastplate
Description: This battered yet lovingly polished breastplate is marked by three chipped glass circles set over the heart, each of a different color. Three times per day, the wearer of this +1 breastplate may tap one of the three chipped glass circles to activate it, enveloping her in a shimmering aura that protects her from harm. The wearer gains DR 10/— and is protected if she were under the effects of a globe of invulnerability spell. The effect ends as soon as the wearer makes an offensive action or casts an offensive spell, or after 1 minute. In addition, whenever the wearer casts a cure spell or administers a cure potion while under this effect, she may add one additional die to the total amount of damage healed.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: cure light wounds, sanctuary

Name: Flashguard Plate
Description: This +2 breastplate is made of scrap metal from remnants of a crashed spaceship. Specifically designed to provide additional defense against beam weapons, it grants its wearer a +4 bonus to touch AC against ray attacks. Three times per day, when a ray attack targeting the plate’s wearer misses by 4 or less, the wearer can deflect the ray back at its source as an immediate action. The ray uses the original attack roll to determine whether it hits its new target.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: deflection, shield

Name: Folding Plate
Description: This item normally looks like a heavy steel brooch or cloak clasp, often depicting a heavy helm or sturdy shield. On command, the brooch transforms in a clatter of metallic plates and panels to instantly cover the wearer in a complete suit of +1 full plate, with the design of the brooch displayed on the armor’s breastplate. The same command word causes the armor to transform into the brooch. The brooch only transforms if the wearer’s armor slot is unoccupied, thus it won’t work if the wearer is already armored. The brooch associated with this armor weighs less than a pound and occupies the neck slot when in this form.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: instant summons

Name: Forgemaster's Half-Plate
Aura: faint abjuration, divination, evocation, and transmutation
Description: This +1 half-plate is usually sized for a dwarf and decorated with one or more hammer-shaped symbols. Once per day, the wearer may use mending, protection from evil, and spark. Once per day as a full-round action, the wearer can attempt a Knowledge check (with a +10 bonus) to identify a creature he is currently in combat with, even if he possesses no ranks in the appropriate Knowledge skill

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: know the enemy, mending, protection from evil, spark

Name: Forsaken Banded Mail
Description: A massive skull adorns the chest piece of this suit of +1 banded mail, and smaller gilted images of defaced holy symbols cover the other parts of the armor. The wearer of the armor cannot cast divine spells or use any spell-like supernatural ability gained from a connection to a deity. The wearer gains SR 19 against any divine-origin spell, spell-like ability, or supernatural ability (such as a domain granted power or ability from an outsider serving a deity), and treats the armor’s enhancement bonus as +2 higher against creatures with these abilities.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Special: creator cannot be a divine spellcaster

Name: Full Plate of the Corpse
Description: This suit of +2 full plate has been etched and stained in such a way that it resembles the form and shape of a decomposed body that is encased in a suit of armor. The wearer is effectively hidden from non-intelligent undead, which can’t see, hear, or smell him; even extraordinary or supernatural senses capabilities can’t penetrate the magical shroud. An intelligent undead creature can attempt a single Will saving throw (DC 14) to penetrate the ward. All affected undead behave as if the wearer simply isn’t there.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: hide from undead

Name: Gale Armor
Description: Gale armor is a suit of +3 silken ceremonial armor that floats weightlessly when not worn. Gale armor has no weight of its own and confers limited weightlessness on its wearer. The wearer of a suit of gale armor can use air walk up to 10 rounds per day. Activating or deactivating this ability is a free action, and these rounds need not be consecutive. Additionally, the wearer of a suit of gale armor is permanently under the effect of glide, and if he’s capable of flying, the armor increases his maneuverability by one category.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: air walk, glide

Name: Gelugon Armor
Description: This +4 full plate is fashioned to make the wearer appear to be an ice devil, complete with insectile eyes. Frosty blue energy emanates from the armor’s joints, and the helm’s eyes intermittently surge with diabolical power. The armor has a long, spear-like tail that can be used to make a single primary natural attack per round as a standard action if the wearer makes no other attacks. This tail attack deals 1d10 points of damage plus 2d6 points of cold damage for a Medium wearer. The tail can also be used to make attacks of opportunity that count against the wearer’s maximum number of attacks of opportunity per round.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: resist energy, Special: creator must be lawful evil

Name: Gelugon Plate
Description: This iridescent +3 Hellknight plate is cold to the touch, and the fiendish features that swirl across the plates shed gouts of cold mist. The wearer of this armor gains cold resistance 10. Any creature that ends its movement within 5 feet of the wearer must succeed at a DC 16 Fortitude saving throw or be staggered for 1 round, numbed by the cold emitted by the armor. A creature that succeeds at its saving throw is immune to the effects of that gelugon plate for 24 hours. The wearer of a suit of gelugon plate can suppress or reactivate this effect as a standard action. A Hellknight (or Hellknight signifer with heavy armor proficiency) wearing this armor can cast wall of ice three times per day.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: slow, wall of ice

Name: Ghoul Hide
Description: This morbid +1 hide armor is stitched from the flesh torn from the bodies of ghoul servants as a punishment for failing their masters in some manner. The wearer of this armor is immune to the paralytic touch of ghouls, ghasts, and lacedons. If the wearer is the subject of a bite attack or is swallowed whole, the attacker must succeed at a DC 13 Fortitude save or contract ghoul fever.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: ghoul touch

Name: Giant-Hide Armor (Ogre)
Description: This drooping, many-folded suit of +3 hide armor is made from the tanned skin of an actual giant. Once per day on command, the wearer can grow to match the size of the appropriate giant, as if using giant form I (ogre). This transformation lasts up to 15 minutes, and ends when the wearer commands. Most good folk consider wearing the skins of intelligent creatures to be abhorrent. Giants gain a +2 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls against the wearer, or +4 if the wearer’s armor is made from the same kind of giant as the attacker.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: giant form I

Name: Giant-Hide Armor (Hill Giant)
Description: This drooping, many-folded suit of +3 hide armor is made from the tanned skin of an actual giant. Once per day on command, the wearer can grow to match the size of the appropriate giant, as if using giant form I (hill giant). This transformation lasts up to 15 minutes, and ends when the wearer commands. Most good folk consider wearing the skins of intelligent creatures to be abhorrent. Giants gain a +2 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls against the wearer, or +4 if the wearer’s armor is made from the same kind of giant as the attacker.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: giant form I

Description: This drooping, many-folded suit of +3 hide armor is made from the tanned skin of an actual giant. Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: giant form I

Description: This drooping, many-folded suit of +3 hide armor is made from the tanned skin of an actual giant. This transformation lasts up to 15 minutes, and ends when the wearer commands. Most good folk consider wearing the skins of intelligent creatures to be abhorrent. Description: This drooping, many-folded suit of +3 hide armor is made from the tanned skin of an actual giant. Description: This drooping, many-folded suit of +3 hide armor is made from the tanned skin of an actual giant. This transformation lasts up to 15 minutes, and ends when the wearer commands. Most good folk consider wearing the skins of intelligent creatures to be abhorrent. Name: Giant-Hide Armor (Storm Giant)
Description: This drooping, many-folded suit of +3 hide armor is made from the tanned skin of an actual giant. Once per day on command, the wearer can grow to match the size of the appropriate giant, as if using giant form II (storm giant). This transformation lasts up to 15 minutes, and ends when the wearer commands. Most good folk consider wearing the skins of intelligent creatures to be abhorrent. Giants gain a +2 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls against the wearer, or +4 if the wearer’s armor is made from the same kind of giant as the attacker.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: giant form II

Name: Gloom Mail
Description: This ugly +1 chainmail resists polishing and easily acquires bent links and other cosmetic damage from everyday use, though such blemishes never impair its function as armor. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can afflict one target within 30 feet with bad luck, giving it a –2 penalty to Armor Class, on attack rolls, or on saving throws (wearer’s choice) for 1 minute. In addition, once per day, the wearer can use protection from good

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: bestow curse, protection from good, Special: Curse subdomain or evil eye hex

Name: Gossamer Shrouds of the Clairvoyant
Description: This sky-blue suit of mistmail has the glamered armor special ability, and can once per day create a dramatic spectacle of twinkling lights, as the rainbow pattern spell. The armor is prone to dramatic soliloquies about its “prophetic visions” and “sight beyond the mystical veils”; however, it lacks actual divinatory powers. Alignment chaotic neutral; Senses 120 ft.; Intelligence 14; Wisdom 10; Charisma 14; Ego 7; Communication Speech (Auran, Celestial, Common)

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: disguise self, obscuring mist, rainbow pattern

Name: Gravewatcher Chainmail
Description: This blue-white +1 deathless chainmail is made of an intricate pattern of light and dark links that form a spiral-shaped design on the armor’s chest. The wearer can use detect undead, disrupt undead, and light each once per day

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: death ward, detect undead, disrupt undead, light

Name: Gray Master's Leathers
Aura: faint conjuration, evocation, illusion, and transmutation
Description: This +1 shadow leather armor is usually a neutral brown or gray color and is tight-fitting so it can be worn under bulky clothing or a disguise. The wearer can use acid splash, dancing lights, and mage hand each once per day

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: acid splash, dancing lights, invisibility, mage hand, silence

Name: Gug Hide
Description: This grotesque suit of +1 hide armor is stitched together from the hides of gugs. The wearer of a suit of gug hide gains the benefits of Leng’s basic infusion when in an underground environment. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can cause his arms to each split into two arms at the elbow, each bearing a furred hand like that of a horrid subterranean gug. The wearer must designate one hand as his primary hand; all others are considered off hands. He can use any of his hands for other purposes that require free hands. A user who has Two-Weapon Fighting is treated as if he had Multi-Weapon Fighting while these extra arms are activated. This ability lasts for 10 minutes and has no effect if the wearer already has more than two arms.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: alter self, limited wish

Name: Half-Plate of the Dark Prince
Description: This regal-looking +1 half-plate is decorated with red infernal symbols and an inverted pentagram. The wearer can use charm person and infernal healing each once per day

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: charm person, infernal healing

Name: Hamatula Hide
Description: Crafted from the flayed skin of a barbed devil, this imposing +2 spiked hide armor weighs half the normal weight. When its wearer rages, the armor’s spikes elongate and the hide bonds to her skin, providing fire resistance 10. Any creature that strikes the wearer with a melee weapon, unarmed strike, or a natural weapon while the spikes are elongated takes 1d8+6 points of piercing damage from the armor’s barbs (unless using a weapon with reach). While the wearer is enraged, spells that cause additional damage to evil outsiders deal that increased damage to her. A barbarian with fiend totem rage powers gains additional benefits from hamatula hide. If she has the lesser fiend totem rage power, she gains a +1 profane bonus to Armor Class while raging. If she has the fiend totem rage power, the damage caused by her barbs increases to 2d8+6 and stacks with the barbed defense granted by the armor. If she has the greater fiend totem ability, she gains fire resistance 20 when raging.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: resist fire

Name: Hellwasp Corset
Description: This studded leather armor is lavishly adorned with a bound swarm of hellwasps. This +3 studded leather armor prevents the first 20 points of damage the wearer takes each day (resetting at midnight). Once the wasps have prevented 20 points of damage for the day, they angrily animate and swarm around the wearer, and the wearer must make a DC 18 Fortitude save or gain the nauseated condition for 1 round. After 1 round the swarm returns to the corset and goes dormant. Special: The swarm cannot be targeted separately from the armor and cannot be killed unless the armor is destroyed (not just broken.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: lesser planar ally, summon swarm

Name: Hero's Hauberk
Description: The damage reduction of this dull gray +1 adamantine chain shirt stacks with any other damage reduction the wearer possesses. For example, a wearer with DR 5/magic would reduce damage from non-magical attacks by 6, and magical attacks by 1. While the wearer rages or maintains a raging song, the armor emits a low droning sound and grants the benefits of light fortification. While the wearer maintains a bardic performance, the armor’s links jangle in harmony with his song or movements, aiding his focus. The wearer receives a +1 luck bonus on all ability checks and skill checks he attempts during such a performance. In addition, any penalties applied to his attack rolls, ability checks, skill checks, and saving throws are reduced by 1. If a die roll has multiple penalties, the total of the penalties is reduced by 1, not each individual penalty.

Construction.Requirements: Feats:: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: limited wish or miracle, Special: creator must have the raging song class feature

Name: Howling Skull Armor
Description: This suit of +3 studded leather armor is decorated with metal skulls. Once per day as a standard action, the wearer can command the skulls to unleash a cacophonous chorus of howls, causing all creatures within a 30-foot spread to make a DC 16 Will save to avoid becoming frightened for 1d4 rounds. The wearer can choose up to three targets (plus himself) in the area of effect to be exempt from the effect. The wearer of a suit of howling skull armor gains a +4 bonus on all saving throws against fear effects. Each time the wearer of howling skull armor succeeds at a saving throw against a fear effect created by someone other than himself, he gains a +2 bonus on Will saves for 1 round.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: fear

Name: Hunter's Leather
Description: Once per day as a standard action, the wearer of this mottled green-and-brown +1 shadow studded leather can prepare a perfectly aimed shot; as long as the wearer’s next attack roll is made before the end of the next round, this attack ignores the target’s miss chance and AC bonus from cover and concealment (but not total concealment)

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: invisibility, silence, true strike

Name: Infiltrator's Mail
Description: This dull black suit of +2 scale mail does not impose an armor check penalty on the wearer’s Stealth checks, though other armor check penalties apply as normal. Additionally, infiltrator’s mail reacts to detect magic as though it were non-magical and, when worn, extends this effect to all other magic items worn or held by the wearer unless the viewer uses identify or a similar effect while examining the items.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: cat's grace, magic aura

Name: Inheritor's Breastplate
Description: This reflective +1 breastplate is decorated with a sword-and-starburst symbol. The armor is normally a golden color, but in battle it becomes silver-gray. The wearer can use bless weapon and remove fear each once per day

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: bless weapon, remove fear

Name: Invincible Armor
Description: Invincible armor shifts between three different appearances, but always weighs the same and protects as +2 impervious moderate fortification full plate. As an immediate action, the wearer can change the armor into heavy plate that blocks slashing attacks (DR 10/bludgeoning or piercing), thickly layered chainmail that blocks piercing attacks (DR 10/bludgeoning or slashing), or overlapping metal scales that block bludgeoning attacks (DR 10/piercing or slashing). In addition, invincible armor provides the wearer with 5 points of resistance to acid, cold, electricity, fire, and sonic, and is itself unharmed by damage from any of these energy types.

Construction.Requirements: Feats: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells: fabricate, make whole, resist energy, and limited wish or miracle

Name: Judge's Breastplate
Description:
This +1 breastplate is adorned with symbols of law and judgment. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Sense Motive checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can use discern lies (DC 16) for up to 7 rounds.

Discern lies is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, discern lies

Name: Jungle Armor
Description:
This +2 hide armor is overgrown with living vines and leaves that blend seamlessly with dense foliage. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks in jungle terrain and a +4 competence bonus on Survival checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of pass without trace for 7 minutes.

Pass without trace is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, pass without trace

Name: Legion Armor
Description:
This +2 chainmail is engraved with symbols of unity and military precision. The wearer gains a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls and saving throws when adjacent to at least one ally.

Once per day on command, the wearer can grant this morale bonus to all allies within 30 feet for 9 rounds.

The granted bonus is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, heroism

Name: Lifecollar Coat
Description:
This +1 chain coat is fitted with a high collar lined with protective runes. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against energy drain and negative levels.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of lesser restoration.

Lesser restoration is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, lesser restoration

Name: Luck Mail, Lesser
Description:
This +1 chainmail shimmers faintly with protective fortune. Once per day as an immediate action after the wearer fails a saving throw, she can reroll that saving throw. She must take the second result, even if it is worse.

This effect is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, divination

Name: Luck Mail, Greater
Description:
This +2 chainmail radiates a powerful aura of protective fortune. Once per day as an immediate action after the wearer fails a saving throw, she can treat that saving throw as if she had rolled a natural 20.

This effect is CL 13th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, limited wish

Name: Maiden's Panoply
Description:
This +2 full plate is styled in gleaming white and gold and adorned with protective sigils. The wearer gains a +4 sacred bonus on saving throws against fear effects.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of remove fear affecting all allies within 30 feet.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of heroism for 9 rounds.

Remove fear and heroism are CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, heroism, remove fear

Name: Mail of Malevolence
Description:
This +2 chainmail radiates a palpable aura of menace. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Intimidate checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can cast crushing despair (DC 17) centered on herself.

The save DC is Charisma-based.

Crushing despair is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, crushing despair

Name: Mammoth Hide
Description:
This +2 hide armor is crafted from the thick, shaggy hide of a mammoth. The wearer gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength checks made to resist bull rush and trip attempts.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of rage for 9 rounds.

Rage is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, rage

Name: Man Mountain Armor
Description:
This +2 full plate is massive and reinforced with thick plates and heavy rivets. The wearer gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength checks made to resist bull rush, overrun, and trip attempts.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of enlarge person for 9 rounds.

Enlarge person is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, enlarge person

Name: Mistmail
Description:
This +1 chain shirt is perpetually wreathed in a thin veil of drifting mist. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Stealth checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can become insubstantial as if under the effects of gaseous form for up to 7 minutes.

Gaseous form is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, gaseous form

Name: Mithral Full Plate of Speed
Description:
This +3 mithral full plate allows the wearer to move with remarkable swiftness. The wearer can act as if affected by haste for up to 10 rounds per day. These rounds need not be consecutive.

Haste is CL 13th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, haste

Name: Mithral Shirt
Description:
This +1 mithral chain shirt is lighter and more flexible than typical chainmail. It is considered light armor and allows the wearer to use the full Dexterity bonus to AC as if not wearing armor.

Mithral shirt is CL 5th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cat's grace

Name: Morlock Hide
Description:
This +1 hide armor is stitched from the tough, gray skin of morlocks. The wearer gains darkvision 60 feet.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of invisibility for up to 7 minutes.

Invisibility is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, darkvision, invisibility

Name: Mosswater Stained Leather
Description:
This +2 leather armor is dyed in mottled greens and browns, blending perfectly with marshland and forest undergrowth. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks in swamps and forest terrain and a +4 competence bonus on Survival checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of pass without trace for 7 minutes.

Pass without trace is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, pass without trace

Name: Murderer's Blackcloth
Description:
This +1 black leather armor seems to drink in surrounding light. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of invisibility for up to 7 minutes.

Invisibility is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, invisibility

Name: Otyugh Hide
Description:
This +2 hide armor is stitched from the rubbery hide of an otyugh and smells faintly of rot. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against disease and poison.

Once per day on command, the wearer can exude a nauseating stench in a 10-foot radius for 9 rounds. Creatures in the area must succeed at a DC 17 Fortitude save or be sickened for as long as they remain within the area and for 1d4 rounds thereafter.

The save DC is Constitution-based.

The stench is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, stinking cloud

Name: Painspike Armor
Description:
This +2 chainmail is lined with inward-pointing barbs that feed on the wearer’s pain. Whenever the wearer takes damage from a melee attack, the attacker takes 1d6 points of piercing damage.

Three times per day as an immediate action when the wearer takes damage from a melee attack, she can gain a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength for 9 rounds.

The enhancement is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bull's strength

Name: Pallid Chain
Description:
This +2 chain shirt is crafted from bone-white links and feels unnaturally cold. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against energy drain and negative levels.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of false life.

False life is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, false life

Name: Pelt of the Demon Mother
Description:
This +2 hide armor is fashioned from the hide of a powerful demonic beast. The wearer gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength checks made to grapple and a +4 competence bonus on Intimidate checks.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of rage for 9 rounds.

Rage is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, rage

Name: Perfection Leather
Description:
This +1 leather armor is exquisitely crafted and perfectly balanced. The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on Acrobatics and Stealth checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of cat's grace for 7 minutes.

Cat's grace is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cat's grace

Name: Phoenix Armor
Description:
This +3 full plate glows faintly with inner fire and is adorned with phoenix motifs. The wearer gains fire resistance 30.

Whenever the wearer is struck by a melee attack, the attacker takes 2d6 points of fire damage.

Once per day on command, if the wearer is slain, she is restored to life as if by raise dead, and the armor erupts in a 20-foot-radius burst of fire that deals 10d6 points of fire damage (Reflex DC 19 half).

The save DC is Constitution-based.

The burst is CL 13th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fire storm, raise dead

Name: Plate Armor of the Deep
Description:
This +2 full plate is etched with wave and coral motifs and constantly smells faintly of brine. The wearer gains a swim speed of 30 feet and can breathe water as if under the effects of water breathing.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of freedom of movement while underwater for 9 minutes.

Water breathing and freedom of movement are CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, freedom of movement, water breathing

Name: Prismatic Plate
Description:
This +5 full plate constantly shimmers with shifting rainbow hues. The wearer gains spell resistance 19.

Once per day on command, the wearer can surround herself with a prismatic aura that functions as prismatic sphere for 17 rounds.

Prismatic sphere is CL 17th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, prismatic sphere, spell resistance

Name: Purgatory’s Cowl
Description:
This +2 leather cowl is fashioned in the style of a penitent’s hood and is etched with faintly glowing runes. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against death effects and negative energy effects.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of protection from evil for 7 minutes.

Protection from evil is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, protection from evil

Name: Rageskin, Lupine
Description:
This +1 hide armor is fashioned from the hide of a great wolf. While raging, the wearer gains a +2 enhancement bonus to Dexterity and a +4 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of rage for 7 rounds.

Rage is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, rage

Name: Rageskin, Ursine
Description:
This +1 hide armor is fashioned from the hide of a great bear. While raging, the wearer gains a +2 enhancement bonus to Constitution and a +4 competence bonus on Intimidate checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of rage for 7 rounds.

Rage is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, rage

Name: Raiment of Chains
Description:
This +2 chainmail is adorned with lengths of dangling, animated chain. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on grapple checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can cause the chains to lash out at a creature within 10 feet, making a melee touch attack that deals 2d6 points of bludgeoning damage and attempts to start a grapple using the wearer’s CMB.

The animated chains are CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, animate rope

Name: Raiment of the Shining Crusade
Description:
This +2 chainmail gleams with radiant light and is engraved with symbols of righteous battle. The wearer gains a +4 sacred bonus on saving throws against evil spells and spell-like abilities.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can emit a 20-foot-radius burst of holy light that deals 5d6 points of damage to evil creatures (Will DC 17 half).

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of holy smite.

The save DC is Charisma-based.

The burst and holy smite are CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, holy smite

Name: Red Stalker Armor
Description:
This +2 chain shirt is dyed a deep crimson and seems to blur slightly when observed. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of blur for 7 minutes.

Blur is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, blur

Name: Rhino Hide
Description:
This +2 hide armor is made from rhinoceros hide. The armor grants its wearer a +2 enhancement bonus on Strength checks made to charge, and once per day on command the wearer can make a charge attack that deals an extra 2d6 points of damage.

This effect is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bull's strength

Name: Rosy Hauberk
Description:
This +1 chainmail is tinted a soft rose hue and carries a faint fragrance of blossoms. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can cast calm emotions (DC 16).

The save DC is Charisma-based.

Calm emotions is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, calm emotions

Name: Scarab Breastplate
Description:
This +2 breastplate is decorated with golden scarab motifs and tiny protective glyphs. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against curses and death effects.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of remove curse.

Remove curse is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, remove curse

Name: Scouting Leather
Description:
This +1 leather armor is fitted with numerous small pockets and reinforced stitching. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Perception checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of detect secret doors for 7 minutes.

Detect secret doors is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, detect secret doors

Name: Sea Banshee Coat
Description:
This +2 chain coat is damp and smells faintly of salt and brine. The wearer gains a swim speed of 20 feet.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can emit a wail in a 30-foot radius. Enemies in the area must succeed at a DC 16 Fortitude save or be shaken for 1d4 rounds.

The save DC is Constitution-based.

The wail is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fear, water breathing

Name: Sea Coat
Description:
This +1 chain coat is always slightly damp but never rusts. The wearer gains a swim speed of 20 feet and a +4 competence bonus on Swim checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of water breathing for 7 minutes.

Water breathing is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, water breathing

Name: Shifting Jerkin
Description:
This +1 leather jerkin seems to subtly change color and texture to match its surroundings. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of alter self for 7 minutes.

Alter self is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, alter self

Name: Sky Knight Dress Uniform
Description:
This +2 mithral chain shirt is styled as a formal military uniform adorned with sky-themed insignia. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Fly checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of fly for 9 minutes.

Fly is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fly

Name: Snailplate
Description:
This +2 full plate is encrusted with heavy spiral plates resembling a giant snail’s shell. The wearer gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength checks made to resist bull rush and trip attempts.

Once per day on command, the wearer can retract into the armor as a full-round action, gaining total cover until she emerges as another full-round action.

This effect is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, meld into stone

Name: Snakescale Armor
Description:
This +2 scale mail is fashioned from overlapping serpent scales. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against poison.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of resist energy (acid only) for 7 minutes.

Resist energy is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, resist energy

Name: Soothsayer's Raiment
Description:
These +1 robes are embroidered with mystic sigils and tiny crystal beads. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Knowledge (arcana) and Knowledge (planes) checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of augury.

Augury is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, augury

Name: Stalking Armor
Description:
This +2 leather armor is dark and matte, its surface subtly shifting to match its surroundings. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of invisibility for up to 7 minutes.

Invisibility is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, invisibility

Name: Starfaring Robes
Description:
These +2 robes are embroidered with constellations that shimmer faintly in dim light. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Knowledge (planes) checks and does not need to breathe while in a vacuum.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of fly for 9 minutes.

Fly is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, fly, air bubble

Name: Starsong Mail
Description:
This +2 chainmail hums faintly with celestial harmony. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Perform (sing) checks and a +2 morale bonus on saving throws against fear effects.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can cast good hope.

Good hope is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, good hope

Name: Stone-Eater Armor
Description:
This +2 full plate is rough and pitted, resembling unfinished stone. The wearer gains a burrow speed of 10 feet through earth and unworked stone.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of meld into stone for up to 9 minutes.

Meld into stone is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, meld into stone, passwall

Name: Suit of Inverted Jade
Description:
This +3 full plate is crafted from dark green jade veined with black. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against death effects and negative energy effects.

Whenever the wearer is struck by a melee attack, the attacker takes 2d6 points of negative energy damage.

Once per day on command, the wearer can emit a 20-foot-radius burst of negative energy that deals 10d6 points of damage to living creatures (Will DC 19 half).

The save DC is Constitution-based.

The burst is CL 13th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, enervation, slay living

Name: Tiger's Hide
Description:
This +1 hide armor is fashioned from the striped hide of a great tiger. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks and a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength checks made to jump.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of cat's grace for 7 minutes.

Cat's grace is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cat's grace

Name: Tireless Tracking Hide
Description:
This +2 hide armor is dyed in earthy browns and greens and stitched with subtle tracking runes. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Survival checks and does not take penalties on Perception checks while moving at full speed.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of locate creature.

Locate creature is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, locate creature

Name: Toiler's Armor
Description:
This +1 breastplate is reinforced with practical fittings and durable plates. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Profession checks and a +2 enhancement bonus on Strength checks made to lift or carry heavy loads.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of bear's endurance for 7 minutes.

Bear's endurance is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bear's endurance

Name: Trained Barding
Description:
This +1 barding is crafted to fit a specific mount and decorated with heraldic insignia. The mount gains a +4 competence bonus on Handle Animal checks and a +2 morale bonus on saving throws against fear effects.

Three times per day on command, the barding can grant the mount the benefits of heroism for 7 minutes.

Heroism is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, heroism

Name: Tunnel Defender Stoneplate
Description:
This +2 full plate is carved from solid stone and reinforced with dwarven craftsmanship. The wearer gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength checks made to resist bull rush and overrun attempts.

While standing on stone or earth, the wearer gains a +2 bonus to AC against charge attacks.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of stone shape.

Stone shape is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, stone shape

Name: Veiled Chain
Description:
This +2 chain shirt is covered in thin, gauzy veils that obscure its true form. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Disguise checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of disguise self for up to 7 minutes.

Disguise self is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, disguise self

Name: Veiled Chain
Description:
This +2 chain shirt is covered in thin, gauzy veils that obscure its true form. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Disguise checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of disguise self for up to 7 minutes.

Disguise self is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, disguise self

Name: Warden of the Woods
Description:
This +2 hide armor is overgrown with living leaves and bark-like plates. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Survival checks and a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength checks made to grapple.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of barkskin for 9 minutes.

Barkskin is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, barkskin

Name: Waverider Breastplate
Description:
This +2 breastplate is etched with stylized waves and sea creatures. The wearer gains a swim speed of 20 feet and a +4 competence bonus on Swim checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of water walk for 7 minutes.

Water walk is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, water walk

Name: Wizard's Mail
Description:
This +2 chain shirt is inscribed with arcane sigils and protective glyphs. The wearer gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of dispel magic.

Dispel magic is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, dispel magic

Name: Workman's Armor
Description:
This +1 breastplate is reinforced with sturdy straps and practical fittings. The wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on Craft and Profession checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of bear's endurance for 7 minutes.

Bear's endurance is CL 7th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, bear's endurance

Name: Writhing Armor
Description:
This +3 chainmail appears to be composed of writhing, living tendrils. The wearer gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength checks made to grapple and a +4 competence bonus on Escape Artist checks.

Whenever the wearer successfully grapples a creature, the target takes 2d6 points of bludgeoning damage.

Once per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of freedom of movement for 13 rounds.

Freedom of movement is CL 13th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, freedom of movement

Name: Xill Carapace Armor
Description:
This +2 hide armor is fashioned from the chitinous carapace of a xill. The wearer gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength checks made to grapple and a +4 competence bonus on Escape Artist checks.

Three times per day on command, the wearer can gain the benefits of dimension door.

Dimension door is CL 9th.

Construction.Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, dimension door
